title: Editing Models
description: Request and response models for design-time editing: structural changes to the live tree, clearing properties, XAML reload and the in-app selection overlay.

AddElementRequest.description: Inflate a single view from XAML and insert it into the parent named in the path. Layouts insert at index; single-content parents (ContentPage, Border, ScrollView, ContentView, ...) must be empty.

xaml.description: XAML for exactly one view. The default MAUI namespace and the x: namespace are supplied when the snippet does not declare them. x:Class is not allowed.

index.description: Position among the parent's children. Omitted, negative or past the end appends. Ignored for single-content parents.

MoveElementRequest.description: Move the element named in the path to a new parent, or reorder it within its current parent.

parentId.description: Target parent element. May be the element's current parent to reorder.

index.description: The element's final position among the target's children. Omitted or out of range appends.

CaptureBinding.description: Optional capture metadata for requests that otherwise carry no body. May also be supplied as captureEpoch and registryGeneration query parameters.

ElementEditResponse.description: Result of adding or moving an element.

element.description: The element as it now appears in the tree, including its new id and children.

parentId.description: The parent the element now belongs to.

index.description: Position among the parent's children; null for single-content parents.

parentId.description: The parent the element was removed from.

value.description: The formatted value after clearing, i.e. the style or default value.

EditError.description: A structural edit or reload that could not be applied.

details.description: For invalid-xaml during reload: the parse error position, when known.

XamlReloadRequest.description: Re-inflate live pages or views from XAML text. Resources, behaviors, triggers, gesture recognizers, toolbar items, single content, layout children, Shell items and multi-page children on the root are reset before inflation and restored when inflation fails; generated x:Name fields are re-pointed at the new elements, and cleared for names the document no longer declares.

xaml.description: The complete XAML document, normally including x:Class.

className.description: Type to reload. Defaults to the document's x:Class.

elementId.description: Reload only this live instance. Its type must match the class when one is known.

sourceFile.description: Project-relative path for the refreshed source map when the app has no build-time map for the type.

sourceHash.description: Content hash of the replaced source map. Elements of the reloaded type report this as sourceHash from now on. Null when no source map could be built.

elementId.description: Element to outline inside the app. Null or omitted clears every highlight.

enabled.description: While enabled, the next tap in the app selects the element under it instead of interacting with it. Pick mode turns itself off after one pick.
